title: Guard start/resume transitions
summary: Route all task starts through lifecycle cleanup and simplify Resume Required presentation.
description: `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3922` and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:899` only reject generic in-progress updates when `pauseSnapshot` exists, while `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:722` has the same narrow API guard. `task_start` is the canonical lifecycle implementation: it resumes checkpoints and marks matching deviations resumed (`packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:4320-4348`; `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1334-1366`). The Web UI task editor currently exposes generic status selection in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-edit-modal.route.tsx:30` and submits generic updates via `task-edit.action.ts:29`. Add a dedicated server start/resume path, make generic updates refuse entering in-progress, use the lifecycle action in the Web UI, and remove the redundant row-level label from `components/layout/app-shell.tsx`. Preserve valid pause behavior: a paused task is planned with a checkpoint until lifecycle resume; preserve non-lifecycle status editing. Add server, adapter/MCP, and UI regression coverage.

tasks.title: Implement guarded start/resume lifecycle
tasks.description:
Implement the resume integrity fix across the adapters, HTTP server, and Web UI. In `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts:3922` and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts:899`, reject every generic transition into `in-progress`, not only checkpoint-backed transitions; retain `task_start` as the path that calls `PlanStore.resumeTask` and `setWorkDeviationState(..., "resumed")` (`pi-adapter/src/index.ts:4320-4348`, `plan-mcp/src/index.ts:1334-1366`). In `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts:710`, provide a dedicated guarded start/resume endpoint that performs equivalent lifecycle cleanup and prevents conflict with existing active work; generic PUT must reject entering in-progress. Update `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-edit-modal.route.tsx` and actions/API to use an explicit Start/Resume control rather than a status dropdown transition. Remove the redundant Resume Required badge in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/layout/app-shell.tsx:42`, keeping only the section heading. Add regression tests for a deviation-only pending resume: generic start attempt fails; lifecycle start makes it active and removes it from `/tasks/focus` pendingResume. Preserve pause semantics and non-lifecycle status changes.

---
**Completion summary:**
Implemented and validated the guarded start/resume lifecycle. Changed `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` and `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts` so generic status updates cannot enter in-progress. Added `POST /tasks/:id/start` in `packages/plan-server/src/serve.ts`, resolving checkpoints and matching resume deviations atomically with lifecycle status updates; generic HTTP PUT now refuses in-progress transitions. Added Web UI Start/Resume action route/API and task-detail control in `packages/plan-web-ui/src/routes/task-start.action.ts`, `src/lib/api.ts`, `src/app/router.tsx`, and `src/routes/task-detail/route.tsx`; removed in-progress selection for non-active tasks and the duplicate per-row Resume Required badge. Rebuilt bundled Web UI assets. Regression coverage updated across server, MCP, Pi adapter, and Web UI. Validated with `pnpm build`, `pnpm check`, `pnpm test:unit` (392 tests passed), and `node --test packages/plan-server/test/server-events.test.mjs` (9 tests passed). No commit or push performed.
